agentic.summary: Agent improperly requested full card number and failed to offer escalation when a complaint was requested. Verification, promises and conduct otherwise compliant based on the transcript excerpt.

findings.quote: its standard for us. and while we have you, what is your full card number?
findings.explanation: The agent asked for the customer's full card number. Policy explicitly forbids asking for, repeating or writing out a full payment card number; such requests are a major violation of the personal and payment data rules.

findings.quote: i see, i can help you with your dispute over yesterdays prce
findings.explanation: The customer explicitly said they wanted to submit a complaint (turn 2). When a customer makes a complaint the agent must acknowledge it and offer an escalation route (supervisor, complaint form or internal team). The agent acknowledged and proceeded to handle the dispute but did not offer any escalation option or inform the customer of how to formally escalate, which is a minor escalation violation.

full.summary: Agent asked for unnecessary and disallowed personal/payment data and issued a promo code while identity verification was incomplete.

findings.quote: just so i can pull up your profile, what is your date of birth?
findings.explanation: The agent requested the customer's date of birth, which is not required for this task. To find or pull up an account the policy allows full name or account ID; asking for date of birth is collecting extra personal data the task does not need (minor violation).

findings.quote: its standard for us. and while we have you, what is your full card number?
findings.explanation: The agent asked for the customer's full payment card number. The policy explicitly forbids asking for, repeating or writing out a full card number (major violation).

The agent provided a promo code (system turn 24: "A promo code has been created." and agent turn 25) and thus completed an account/order action while identity verification was still in progress (system turn 14: "Identity verification in progress ..."). For billing/price disputes or compensatory actions, full verification is required (e.g., full name, account ID and order ID or username/email as per the guidelines). The transcript shows no completed full verification (no email/username collected), so an action was taken without completing required verification (major violation).

rag.summary: Agent asked for full card number (PCI violation) and failed to acknowledge/offer escalation when the customer said they wanted to submit a complaint. No other policy violations found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: its standard for us. and while we have you, what is your full card number?
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asked for the customer's full card number. Policy forbids asking for, repeating or writing out a full payment card number or security code; this is a major violation.

After the customer said they wanted to submit a complaint (turn 2), the agent did not acknowledge the complaint or offer an escalation route (supervisor/complaint form/internal team). Ignoring a request to submit a complaint is a major violation.
